title: 5. Teen anxiety: how to cope, using skills, and surviving school
description_html: In this episode, we talk about anxiety. Between personal experiences, breaking down what panic attacks feel like, and why anxiety gets in the way of things, the listener gets a well-rounded view of how anxiety works.
summary: this episode dives into teen anxiety—what it feels like day-to-day, how panic attacks actually happen in your body, and why anxiety makes everyday things like school feel impossible. sadie shares personal experiences to help listeners recognize their own patterns and understand they're not alone. you'll come away with a clearer picture of how anxiety works and why it shows up the way it does.
